# Reading the files and setting up
```{r}
rm(list=ls())
pacman::p_load(dplyr, readr, data.table, tidyr, gt)
setwd('C:/Data/Shared Folder/People/Rubyath/Data/Working files/Intermediate data/Period 1')
std_cc1 <- read_csv2("std_cc1_co_cov.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
setwd('C:/Data/Shared Folder/People/Rubyath/Data/Working files/Intermediate data/Period 2')
std_cc2 <- read_csv2("std_cc2_co_cov.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
setwd('C:/Data/Shared Folder/People/Rubyath/Data/Working files/Intermediate data/Period 3')
std_cc3 <- read_csv2("std_cc3_co_cov.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Category for CCI
std_cc1 <- std_cc1 %>% mutate(cci_cat = factor(case_when(cci_score <= 1 ~ "0-1", cci_score >= 2 & cci_score <= 4 ~ "2-4", cci_score >= 5 ~ ">=5", TRUE ~ NA_character_)))
std_cc2 <- std_cc2 %>% mutate(cci_cat = factor(case_when(cci_score <= 1 ~ "0-1", cci_score >= 2 & cci_score <= 4 ~ "2-4", cci_score >= 5 ~ ">=5", TRUE ~ NA_character_)))
std_cc3 <- std_cc3 %>% mutate(cci_cat = factor(case_when(cci_score <= 1 ~ "0-1", cci_score >= 2 & cci_score <= 4 ~ "2-4", cci_score >= 5 ~ ">=5", TRUE ~ NA_character_)))
```
# Continuous summary, pre-pandemic
```{r}
summary_cont1 <- std_cc1 %>% group_by(organism_inf_new) %>% summarise(across(.cols = c(age_year, days_of_stay), .fns = list(median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), q1 = ~quantile(.x, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), q3 = ~quantile(.x, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"), .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(summary_cont1)
```
# Continuous summary, pandemic
```{r}
summary_cont2 <- std_cc2 %>% group_by(organism_inf_new) %>% summarise(across(.cols = c(age_year, days_of_stay), .fns = list(median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), q1 = ~quantile(.x, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), q3 = ~quantile(.x, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"), .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(summary_cont2)
```
# Continuous summary, post-pandemic
```{r}
summary_cont3 <- std_cc3 %>% group_by(organism_inf_new) %>% summarise(across(.cols = c(age_year, days_of_stay), .fns = list(median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), q1 = ~quantile(.x, probs = 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), q3 = ~quantile(.x, probs = 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"), .groups = "drop")

knitr::kable(summary_cont3)
```
# Categorical summary, pre-pandemic
```{r}
summary_cat1 <- std_cc1 %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(sex, education_level_recoded, mig_background, cci_cat, bac_coinf, icu, mech_ven, mort_30days), names_to = "variable", values_to = "category") %>% count(organism_inf_new, variable, category, name = "freq") %>% group_by(organism_inf_new, variable) %>% mutate(percentage = (freq/sum(freq)) * 100) %>% ungroup()

head(summary_cat1)

summary_cat1_table <- summary_cat1 %>% mutate(display_val = paste0(freq, " (", round(percentage, 2), "%)")) %>% select(organism_inf_new, variable, category, display_val) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = organism_inf_new, values_from = display_val)

gt(summary_cat1_table)
```
